From April 11, to June 1, 2022, a trial held in Virginia between formerly married couple, Johnny Depp and Amber Heard stormed and stunned the whole world. During that period, millions of viewers across the globe have [[1]] to watch the legal battle. In the first beginning, it seemed that Amber dominated the stage. However, as the drama [[2]], a new star has stepped into the spotlight: Mr. Depp’s lawyer, Camille Vasquez.
The young lawyer from California has caught the attention of millions among the trial her client [[3]] his ex-wife. The trial was livestreamed, receiving widespread viewership around the world, which developed a significant [[4]] in search of her name. T-shirts adorned with her name and articles praising her are being [[5]] and distributed on social media platforms.
Unintentionally and surprisingly, Ms. Vasquez has become a “co-star” of the show. Meanwhile, her sharp legal style has won her many fans. In a two-minute-long video, Ms. Vasquez repeatedly interrupted Ms. Heard’s attorney to “[[6]]”—a legal term used to file a formal protest in court. In just a couple of days, this video drew attention worldwide and has accumulated over 27 million views on TikTok. Even the magazine Vogue called her a(n) [[7]] celebrity because of this trial.
Vasquez distinguished herself in the trial with her questioning style—sometimes [[8]], sometimes aggressive. Moreover, she calmly guided Depp through his testimony and repeatedly hammered Heard with questions suggesting she was a liar. Finally, she persuaded the [[9]] to disbelieve Heard and won the trial. Soon after the trial, Vasquez was promoted from associate to partner at her firm, Brown Rudnick. “Historically, we used to [[10]] this announcement for the end of our fiscal year. But Camille’s stunning performance during the Johnny Depp trial proved to the world that she was ready to take this next step now,” William Baldiga, the chairman and CEO of Brown Rudnick, said in a press release.
